items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So I said 'All right.' I said 'Senator, we're having a problem with this van we got. We don't have transportation.'

ctx.x: He said, 'That's a horse of another color.' He said, 'I'll tell you what I'll do. You come down to the hotel...' That's why we went to the hotel. And that's why... He must have sent somebody to see who we were, standing there, and he must have been up there deciding what he was going to do. So he said, 'Come the next day.'

Well, I'm determined, see, because Paul was telling me, 'Maybe you can get the Senator to let you have one of them station wagons, since you advertised for Hadicol(?) so well' or something. So I came over and I brought a whole plan. We will do block dances, send a (?) for the Hadicol Company, we'll charge admission to the block dance in every little country town in Louisiana, Arkansas and Texas...
